comment: Hand-derived from the documented perf.rs window rules (WINDOW_FRAMES=20, integer nearest-rank percentile ceil(p*len/100), degrade on p95 > 16ms, promote after 3 consecutive windows under 12ms). The mirror module injected into the page must reproduce exactly these tier sequences; when the opurom-core `frames` protocol command lands, these vectors are cross-checked against real perf.rs output.

cases.name: drop then promote after three quiet windows
two over-budget samples drop the window
a window at exactly the target does not drop
